note: R1 S7 completion wave -- this manifest audits what ALREADY EXISTS in this repo against the 28 deterministic protocol fixtures H0.5 froze, and gives each a canonical id. It does NOT invent new fixtures: every 'existing_equivalent' entry points at a real, currently-passing test in this repo (file + exact test name, verified against the source at the time this manifest was written). 'missing' entries are honest gaps -- no fixture exists yet for that slot. Categories mirror the 7 R1 certification gates scripts/r1/certify.ts already runs (ap_gate, cm_gate, recommendation_legality_gate, hidden_info_gate, role_gate, s6_gate, adapter_parity_gate), 4 slots each -- a reasonable, non-arbitrary allocation given those are the categories this program already treats as the R1 protocol/recommendation surface, but this specific 4-per-category split is this manifest's own proposal, not something re-derived from the external H0.5 text (which this repo does not have a copy of).
